_meta.source: docs.optionalpha.com (all 100 doc pages, llms.txt index) studied 2026-07-19
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable catalog of EVERY Option Alpha bot/automation setting, so imported bots capture full fidelity and the template schema/oa_meta covers all of it. Consumed by the bot importer and referenced by app/bots/templates.py.
_meta.note: Values marked default reflect OA documented defaults. Anything OA supports that QuantEdge doesn't map natively is preserved verbatim under a bot's oa_meta key.

allocation.desc: Total capital available to the bot; checked at position entry.

daily_position_limit.desc: Max new positions opened per trading day. Scanner turns off when hit.

max_position_limit.desc: Max positions open at any time. Scanner turns off when hit.

risk_defined_only.desc: Bots may only open defined-risk positions (naked replicated via wide spreads).

scan_speed.desc: Bot-level frequency for scanner + monitor automations.

event.desc: Recurring schedule (first of month, MWF, 3rd Friday, holidays handled)
Fires after the bot opens a position
Fires after the bot closes a position
External call (TradingView/Zapier/Python). One webhook can trigger up to 10 automations across bots.
Manual dashboard button, one click = one run

final_price.desc: Worst price the bot will try. Starts at mid (50%), traverses toward bid(sell)/ask(buy).

slippage_from_mid_usd.desc: e.g. $0.10 from mid; best of the selected options is used

math_operator.desc: In Close Position: references entry price. x1.15=+15% debit, +2.50=+$250/contract, x0.50=50% credit, -0.75=$75 credit/contract

smartpricing.spx_rounding: nearest nickel ($0.05), up when selling / down when buying

triggers.desc: % or $ gain; final price auto-set to lock the minimum profit
% or $ loss (mid at/beyond value; realized may exceed)
Trails high-water gain; tracked every minute
Before Expiration (calendar-day DTE); executes 3:29pm ET on day-based; keeps sending through the day if unfilled

bid_ask_guard.desc: Disable exit / high-low tracking when spread exceeds max width

pdt_box.desc: Wait >=1 day to close, avoid pattern-day-trading

smartpricing.desc: SmartPricing / off / market on the closing order

presets.desc: Save named exit-option presets for reuse

options_expiration_protocol.desc: How the bot handles ITM positions on expiration day. Last moneyness check 10 min before close. OTM positions are never auto-closed. THE 3 SETTINGS:

settings.desc: Estimate P/L from underlying close; bot sends NO order; subject to assignment
Auto-close ITM position with a market order 10 min before close
Bot auto-overrides at 3:50pm ET; trader manually enters results; position leaves bot management

loops.desc: Repeat actions for each open position
Run actions for each listed ticker; only passers continue down Yes path
Loop the bot's custom-watchlist symbols (dynamic sort/filter)

tags.desc: Stateful labels used in decisions; bot tags persist, position/symbol tags scoped to their object

inputs.priority: bot_input > automation_input value > default_value (default used only when the link is broken)
inputs.note: Bot Inputs are NOT updated on bot upgrade/clone — must be re-confirmed

decision_recipe_categories.desc: Price, volatility, IV rank, change%, greeks of a symbol
Daily-close technical indicators (SMA/EMA, RSI, Bollinger, ADX/DX, GEX, etc.)
Open-position metrics: return%, DTE, moneyness, extrinsic/intrinsic value, chance ITM
Candidate-trade filters before opening: rate of return, premium, delta, etc.
Time of day, day of week, economic-news/FOMC events

decision_logic.structure: binary tree (Yes/No paths), no negation by default but NOT property available
decision_logic.conditional_action: runs Yes-branch subset if true, then returns to main flow

pl_metrics.day_pl: intraday total P/L minus previous day's close
pl_metrics.day_pl_pct: day P/L / previous day's net liquid (or allocation)
pl_metrics.max_drawdown: greatest peak-to-trough fall (0 anchor if never < 0)
pl_metrics.avg_win: closed P/L of winners / number of winners
pl_metrics.avg_loss: closed P/L of losers / number of losers
pl_metrics.valuation: mid-price of whole position (not last-trade per leg); excludes commissions/fees

backtester.data: 1-minute historical, up to 3-year window, compare up to 4, combine into one P/L curve
backtester.automate: any backtest -> generate a bot with all its settings/filters

order_handling.partial_fills: timed limit orders; 2-min timeout resets on each partial; leftover canceled -> stays 'open' with partial qty
order_handling.assignment: bots unaware of assignment; must manually override
order_handling.closing: submit BTC/STC, broker reconciles; errors if position absent

failsafes_and_enforcements.excessive_errors_failsafe: automations auto-turn-off after too many errors
failsafes_and_enforcements.leg_enforcement: credit spread short delta > long delta; iron condor 4 strikes; iron butterfly equal short strikes
